description: This file provides UI polish helper functions for the payment interface in an Android app, focusing on validation animations and accessibility announcements.

methods.name: shakeForValidation
methods.description: Performs a brief shake animation on a View to indicate validation failure.

methods.name: pulseSuccess
methods.description: Performs a pulsing animation and changes outline color to indicate validation success, then restores original state.

methods.name: announceForAccessibilityPolite
methods.description: Announces a message to accessibility services in a polite manner.
